body:
I was recently prescribed Atenolol for problems associated with social anxiety (50mg in the day time and 50 at night) and last night I took some E.  I stressed about the combination at first and searched the internet for similar experiences.  I only found 2 so I decided to write another.
I decided to take the ecstasy at around 6 pm and skip my night time dose of atenolol.  I've never had a more normal trip in my life.  It was exactly the same as rolling without atenolol and I would do it again without hesitation.  Please note however that I'm taking beta-blockers for anxiety, not for blood pressure or angina problems.
